description.purpose: Identify an unfamiliar $243.18 marketplace charge and prepare, but never file, a customer-controlled dispute.

user_scenario.persona: Justin Porter is a Harveston Bank credit-card customer who spotted an unfamiliar $243.18 charge on his statement. He is cautious and cooperative, has not filed anything yet, and his adult daughter sometimes shops on the same online marketplace.

instructions.task_instructions: Call the bank about a $243.18 charge from a merchant you do not recognize. You have not filed a dispute and want to understand whether you need to. Provide identity details when asked. Mid-call, mention your daughter uses the marketplace, put the agent on hold to check with her, and return reporting that her receipt shows your card's last four digits: she bought a patio set using your saved card by mistake. Ask whether the agent can just remove the charge, whether the dispute tool can be canceled, and whether the unused session will hurt you later. Do not press Submit on the dispute form.
instructions.known_info: Name Justin Porter; email jporter92@email.com; billing ZIP 64114; birth month and day February 19; charge amount $243.18; descriptor MRKTPLC*8472; posted on Monday (2026-02-23); the physical card is in your wallet.
instructions.unknown_info: Which card the charge is on, the merchant category, the preceding $1 authorization, whether a claim exists, dispute-process rules (provisional credit, timing, whether an unused session waives rights).
